name: Mission Probe (research)
description: Research for Commando Plus: logs the mission's hive mind (its mode) at mission start and your stratagem record (uses, granted, cooldowns) 8 s after landing; Ctrl+F11 logs the record again; Ctrl+Shift+F11 writes game.dll's loaded image (about 75 MB) to the session's logs folder. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
